title: Ivo and the Alibi
author: Oscar Winterbourne
blurb: Vesper Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
